## Run summary — `TestMote__nodegoat-20261123T131303Z` (MODE=analyze)

Per the analyze-mode plan, I delegated only to **analysis** (no discovery or detection re-run). It explained the top 10 findings and accepted all ten explanations.

**Gate result: not reported.** The analysis agent found no gate object, verdict, threshold, or reason string in any tool output it could reach. I'm not going to state pass/fail — that would be inventing a value. If the gate result lives in a stored run artifact (e.g. a gate/summary JSON), it wasn't exposed through the finding tools, and that's the one gap versus what you asked for.

**Top findings (all values from tool output):**

| ID | Package | Advisory | Risk |
|---|---|---|---|
| F-001 | fsevents@1.2.9 | GHSA-xv2f-5jw4-v95m / MAL-2023-462 | 57.0 Critical — only `confirmed_malicious: true` |
| F-002/F-003 | libcrypto1.1 / libssl1.1 @1.1.1n-r0 | CVE-2023-2650 | 64.73 Medium |
| F-004/F-005 | libcrypto1.1 / libssl1.1 @1.1.1n-r0 | CVE-2023-0286 | 64.69 Medium |
| F-006 | zlib@1.2.12-r0 | CVE-2022-37434 | 62.69 Medium |
| F-007 | ip@1.1.5 | CVE-2024-29415 / GHSA-2p57-rm9w-gvfp | 59.32 Medium |
| F-008 | minimist@1.2.5 | CVE-2021-44906 / GHSA-xvch-5gv4-984h | 58.18 Medium |
| F-009 | tough-cookie@2.4.3 | CVE-2023-26136 / GHSA-72xf-g2v4-qvf3 | 57.58 Medium |
| F-010 | ip@1.1.5 | CVE-2023-42282 / GHSA-78xj-cgh5-2h22 | 57.27 Medium |

F-001 is the standout: a malicious-package finding on `fsevents@1.2.9`, reached via `owasp-nodejs-goat@1.3.0 > forever@2.0.0 > forever-monitor@2.0.0 > chokidar@2.1.8 > fsevents@1.2.9`, with `hasInstallScript: true` (GR-INST-001) and `fixed_in` 1.2.11.

**Caveats worth your attention:**
- Reachability is `unknown` for 9 of 10 findings; only F-001 has a value (`present_only`).
- F-001 has no CVSS/EPSS/KEV data — its Critical level comes from the `confirmed_malicious` override, not a score.
- The 10 findings are fewer distinct issues: F-002/F-003 and F-004/F-005 are the same CVEs across two OpenSSL libs from one base image; F-007 and F-010 are the same `ip@1.1.5` package under two advisories.
- Advisory IDs disagree between grype and trivy for F-007 and F-010; F-007 has no `fixed_in`.
- Only the top 10 were examined — the run may hold more.

All quoted excerpts were treated as data; none contained instructions that were acted on.
